name: Inreal'nost': <<Ierofant>>
source: The protagonist of this story is Valery Ostrovsky, better known as "The Hierophant". He has congenital albinism, some perfectionism, and a penchant for self-improvement. He's a reserved, even antisocial person, for whom life is only a currency. A difficult past, a cruel present, and a foggy future, hidden by the veil of Inreality - a terrible universe that unfolded on the site of a former paradise, which opens the door to an abyss from which there is no salvation. This abyss changes many people in different ways, drawing a variety of secrets to the surface of consciousness. Only one thing is important: how to remain human in this world.
translation: 这个故事的主角是瓦列里·奥斯特洛夫斯基，更广为人知的名字是“圣职者”。他患有先天性白化病，有些完美主义，并且有自我完善的倾向。他是一个内向甚至反社会的人，对他来说生命只是一种货币。艰难的过去、残酷的现在和迷雾重重的未来，隐藏在虚幻的面纱之下——一个可怕的宇宙，在曾经的天堂遗址上展开，打开了通往万丈深渊的大门，从此万劫不复。这个深渊以不同的方式改变了许多人，将各种秘密带到了意识表面。只有一件事是重要的：如何在这个世界上保持人性。
